text:
mike: heads-up — preflight for RC-2026.03.21 failed security checks. deploy-bot quarantined the canary. low-severity transitive CVE in libnet v2.4.1 and one artifact in SBOM lacks provenance. change window is 21:30 UTC tonight, decision needed: pin, hotpatch, or delay?

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight results:
- transitive: libnet v2.4.1 -> CVE-2024-XXXX (low)
- SBOM: artifact 'metrics-agent:sha256:abcd...' missing provenance
Action: canary quarantined, staging blocked. logs: https://ci.internal/1756812345

jen: quick q — how many hosts are on the canary and what's customer exposure? can we regional-carveout?

dmitri: internal-only canary (10 hosts), no external customers. libnet used by metrics export path, not model inference path — low exploit surface.

laura: legal-ish note: preliminary scan flags license of a bundled helper as 'restrictive-ish'. tagging @legal for confirmation before GA.

legal: looking. initial read: distribution restrictions may block public GA; internal testing/staging probably OK but need written exception or replacement for GA.

mike: proposal: keep canary quarantined. Options:
1) wait for vendor patch (unknown ETA)
2) pin to different digest (patch not available)
3) implement a local shim to stub libnet exports used by metrics so runtime path is safe, then re-run SBOM/signing and proceed with internal canary/staging only.

jen: option 3 seems fastest. shim would change artifacts (SBOM diff) and require re-sign. also need validation matrix and release note update.

dmitri: I can prototype a shim today — small wrapper that intercepts the metrics export and returns safe values. Non-invasive to inference.

mike: approvals required if we go shim route: @oncall-sre must ok canary uplift after re-sign, @legal signoff for staging/GA constraints, and @prod-signer for SBOM re-sign.

oncall-sre: I can do the uplift after CI + smoke tests. estimate 2 hours for full validation once PR merged.

legal: can approve internal canary & staging with shim as temporary mitigation. Must file a follow-up to resolve licensing before GA. Approve conditional on documentation and changelog entry.

mike: accepted. Plan of record: dmitri implements shim + open PR titled "libnet: temporary shim to mitigate CVE-2024-XXXX" -> jen reviews -> CI runs -> SBOM regenerated and re-signed -> oncall-sre performs canary uplift -> monitor 1h -> if green, keep staging rolling, do not promote to prod until legal clears license. I'll add release-note line: "temporary shim for libnet to mitigate CVE-2024-XXXX while vendor patch is awaited; licensing under review"

deploy-bot: noted. Canary remains quarantined until manual override by oncall-sre. Created changelist: 1756812345-shim-proposal.

jen: I'll draft the release-note snippet + test matrix. ping when PR is open so I can schedule review.

dmitri: starting work now, will push a draft PR in ~90m. will include build instructions so CI can regenerate SBOM and sign.

mike: thanks. keeping timeline tight — aim to have canary validation before the 21:30 window closes. If vendor patch arrives earlier we can drop shim and re-evaluate.

legal: filing a quick remediation ticket and we will track GA-blocker status separately.

oncall-sre: once PR and re-sign done, ping me and I'll coordinate the manual unquarantine and monitor.

jen: noted — prepping docs and watchers. :white_check_mark:
